title: fix(stores): collision-safe art preset and art job ids (MAINT-DEFER-019)
intent: Three id generators built ids from epoch milliseconds, so two calls in the same millisecond collided: an IntegrityError in the SQLite preset store (the CI flake in test_sqlite_art_stores.py), duplicate ids in the live JSON preset store, and a silent upsert-overwrite in the art job store's fallback id. Append uuid4 hex to the millisecond prefix so ids stay time-led and unique.
behavior_change: Newly created preset ids and fallback job ids carry a _<32 hex> suffix. No existing record, schema, route or ordering query changes; ORDER BY created_at is unaffected.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Three one-line id expressions plus uuid imports; one new test module; one SPRINTS.md ledger entry.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No existing manifest or PR touches these generators; owner ruled 2026-10-26 that the flake be repaired with collision-safe ids, independently of PR #462.

commands_run: same new test module run against unfixed origin/main 02032884 code -> 3 failed (UNIQUE constraint failed: art_presets.id; duplicate JSON id; upsert overwrite)
grep -rnE 'f"[^"]*\{int\(time\.time\(\)\s*\*\s*1000\)\}' services/api/app -> exactly the three fixed sites before; none after
